_note: Staged because MCreator was running and rewrites witchercraft.mcreator on save. Apply once MCreator is closed, then delete this file.
_actions: 1. In witchercraft.mcreator mod_elements, retarget the existing QuenHudFill entry to QuenHudPool: name -> QuenHudPool, registry_name -> quen_hud_pool, metadata.files[0] -> src/main/java/net/redboltmedia/witchercraft/procedures/QuenHudPoolProcedure.java

2. Delete elements/QuenHudFill.mod.json and src/main/java/net/redboltmedia/witchercraft/procedures/QuenHudFillProcedure.java (both restored only to keep the live registry from dangling while MCreator is open).

3. Optionally restore "path": "~/GUI" on the WitcherHud entry. MCreator dropped it because that folder does not exist in its element browser; recreating the folder in the GUI and dragging WitcherHud into it is the safer fix.
4. elements/QuenHudPool.mod.json and QuenHudPoolProcedure.java already exist and are what WitcherHud.java calls.
